days.title: Buckow Culture and Nature
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schweizer Haus
stops.detail: In the 'Schweizer Haus', the visitor center of the nature park in Buckow, there is an exhibition about the nature park and information for visitors.

stops.name: Brecht-Weigel-Haus
stops.detail: In Buckow, the museum and event venue Brecht-Weigel-Haus commemorates the artist couple.

stops.name: Poetenstieg
stops.detail: The 'Poetenstieg' is a charming hiking trail that begins in Buckow and leads through the mixed forests and the Silberkehle gorge.

days.title: Central Lakes and Waterways
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schermützelsee
stops.detail: The Schermützelsee is located in the center of the nature park.

stops.name: Stobber
stops.detail: The central watercourse of the nature park is the Stobber.

stops.name: Krugberg
stops.detail: The highest elevation in the nature park is the Krugberg at 129 meters.

stops.name: Rotes Luch
stops.detail: Its crest area with a pseudo-bifurcation is located at 48 m above sea level in the Rotes Luch fen area.

days.title: Northern Trails and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Fledermaus-Museum Julianenhof
stops.detail: A permanent exhibition about bats can be seen in the Fledermaus-Museum Julianenhof.

stops.name: Klostersee
stops.detail: The former Cistercian nunnery Friedland with its monastery church and the Klostersee forms a cultural-historical attraction.

stops.name: Kietzer See
stops.detail: 87.1% of the nature park area is also designated as a European bird sanctuary (SPA), including the Altfriedland pond and lake area bird sanctuary around the Kietzer See in the northeast corner of the nature park.
